name: Data Feed by TTG for WooCommerce
author: Texas Technology Group

sections.description:
Tired of overpriced SAAS platforms, stale product data, and cookie-cutter gun shop websites? So were we.

The Gun Data Feed Plugin by Texas Technology Group is a firepower-heavy solution that drops real-time firearms inventory from top distributors straight into your WooCommerce store: accurate, flexible, and built to scale with your business.

Whether you run a tactical boutique or a full-blown online arsenal, this plugin gives you the tools to build, manage, and dominate your online firearms storefront.

Built for gun dealers, by gun dealers, this is the last product feed tool you’ll ever need.

💥 Why Gun Data Feed Stands Out

  • ✅ Multi-Distributor Support – Sync inventory from major distributors like RSR Group, Sports South, and more.

  • ✅ Live Inventory Refresh – Updates every hour to reflect real stock, not outdated guesses.

  • ✅ Advanced Filters – Exclude junk. Import only what you want by brand, category, price, SKU, or stock.

  • ✅ Dynamic Pricing Rules – Set your own markup, respect MAP, or go full auto on pricing strategy.

  • ✅ Category Mapping – Match distributor categories to WooCommerce for a smooth storefront experience.

  • ✅ Seamless FFL Checkout Integration – Automatically flags FFL and SOT required products at checkout.

  • ✅ Performance First – CDN-hosted images, optimized imports, and minimal server load.

  • ✅ Complete Control – You own your site, your products, your design, no vendor lock-in.

This isn’t just a plugin, it’s a bulletproof backend system built for the unique needs of America’s gun shops.

🔧 Key Features

  • Bulk Import and real-time sync with up-to-the-minute distributor data
  • Filter & curate based on brands, availability, price range, and more
  • Built-in CDN image hosting for fast page loads and SEO wins
  • Auto-pricing with fixed or percentage-based markup
  • Full WooCommerce Category Mapping
  • Optimized for massive catalogs 100,000+ SKUs? No problem
  • Error Logging and transparency for every sync
  • Friendly Admin UI – Easy for techies, easier for non-techs
  • Modular & Scalable – Works with small shops or massive catalogs
  • Regular updates and a public roadmap shaped by user feedback

💰 Pricing

One-time setup: $199.99
Monthly subscription: $49.90
Includes all updates, support, and unlimited data pulls from supported feeds.

– Kinsey’s

– AmChar
– Chattanooga
– (…and 15+ others on our roadmap)

Check our Developer Road Map for the full list. Don’t see your distributor? We offer custom integrations on demand—just ask.

🧠 Coming soon

  • Fastbound Integration – Sync your A&D book directly into your site; turn your on-hand inventory into a live online catalog.
  • Marketplace Integrations – Automatically sync with top traffic drivers:
    • Gun.deals
    • AmmoSeek
    • WikiArms
    • ARMSAGORA
  • Product Type Rules – Use internal product types as filters in restrictions, pricing, and category mapping.

🛠 How It Works

  1. Configure your feed(s) and pricing rules
  2. Plugin pulls distributor product data and syncs to WooCommerce
  3. Products are updated every hour, images, pricing, stock
  4. You sell, ship, and profit with full control

No clunky portals. No third-party restrictions. Just real-time firearm inventory automation, WordPress style.

🚀 Why WordPress + WooCommerce?

  • Open-source and fully customizable
  • Thousands of themes and plugins
  • SEO-optimized, blazing-fast performance
  • Total site ownership, no vendor lock-in
  • Combined with FFL Checkout, it’s the ultimate firearm eCommerce stack

sections.faq:
Can I request support for a specific distributor?

Yes! We offer custom integration for any distributor on demand. Just contact us with the details.

Does this plugin work with FFL Checkout?

Absolutely. It integrates seamlessly with FFL Checkout to ensure compliance and streamline the buyer’s experience for FFL-required items.

Is Fastbound supported?

Fastbound integration is coming soon! You’ll be able to sync your A&D book directly into your online store for real-time inventory and ATF compliance.

Can I filter what products are imported?

Yes. You can include/exclude products by brand, category, price, stock level, distributor, and more using advanced filtering rules.

How does dynamic pricing work?

You set your own pricing rules, fixed dollar amounts or percentage markups. The system respects MAP pricing automatically where applicable.

Can I delete imported products?

Yes. We include a one-click cleanup tool to bulk delete all plugin-imported products if you want to reset your catalog.

What happens if a distributor goes out of stock?

The plugin automatically updates product availability. If something goes out of stock with the distributor, it’s hidden from your woocommerce store.

Can I include my own manually added products in marketplace feeds?

Yes. Marketplace integrations aren’t limited to distributor-imported products. You can include any product from your WooCommerce store, custom-built, exclusive items, or used gear, right alongside synced products in your Gun.deals, AmmoSeek, WikiArms, and ARMSAGORA feeds.

How do marketplace integrations work?

The plugin automatically creates and updates XML or API-compatible data feeds that sync your product inventory, prices, and stock levels with supported marketplaces.

Is there a cost to use marketplace integrations?

No extra cost for integration from us. However, individual marketplaces (like AmmoSeek or WikiArms) may require a retailer account or certification.

Do I need to be a developer to use this?

Not at all. The plugin is designed with a clean, user-friendly UI that’s easy for store owners.

Is this plugin compatible with caching and optimization plugins?

Yes. We follow WooCommerce standards and use background jobs, so it plays nicely with most performance tools.

Is there any setup help or onboarding support?

Yes. We offer documentation, video tutorials, and direct support to help you get started quickly.
